purpose: Detect concatenation into child_process.exec or system shells using safe non-destructive echo probe.
expected_secure_behavior: Input treated strictly as argument data or rejected by input validator; no command execution occurs.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server response or logs output the echoed sentinel token 'cmdi_sentinel_01'.
remediation: Avoid child_process.exec. Use child_process.execFile() or spawn() with argument arrays and shell: false.

purpose: Detect command chaining via pipe operators.
expected_secure_behavior: Pipe character is sanitized, rejected, or passed as a literal string to subprocess.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Second command executes in subshell and returns sentinel in output.
remediation: Do not pass user inputs to shell commands. If execution is mandatory, validate against strict regex (e.g. /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/).
